description: This file defines a React component for a styled menu item, including its props, styling, and interaction logic, used within a menu system in a Mattermost web application.

methods.name: MenuItem
methods.description: React component for rendering a customizable menu item with support for icons, labels, destructive actions, and submenus.

methods.name: MenuItemStyled
methods.description: Styled component based on Material-UI's MenuItem, with custom styles for destructive actions, labels, and hover/focus states.

methods.name: isCorrectKeyPressedOnMenuItem
methods.description: Utility function to determine if a menu item was activated via keyboard (Enter/Space) or mouse click.

methods.name: isRoleCheckboxOrRadio
methods.description: Utility function to check if a role is 'menuitemcheckbox' or 'menuitemradio'.
